# Ember & Oak Events
> Full-service wedding and event planning in Savannah, Georgia. Luxury design and stress-free coordination.

## About
A wedding and event planning company in Savannah, GA. Packages: Day-of Coordination $1,800, Partial Planning $4,500, Full Planning $8,000+. Weddings, corporate events, celebrations. Trusted vendor network. Gallery with event categories.
